device.description: 24-bit 2-channel delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), 120 SPS at 2 MHz CLK
device.note: ads1222.pdf (SBAS314B) p.3-4 electrical characteristics (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, logic levels, data rate 120 SPS at fCLK = 2 MHz), p.5 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.11-12 DRDY/DOUT, SCLK, settling, p.13 data format (Table 2), data retrieval, p.14 data retrieval timing (Figure 25: t4 = 50 ns, t7 = 8.32 ms), p.15 self-calibration, standby

registers.name: MUX
registers.note: internal: MUX pin level (Table 1, p.8); 0 = AINP1/AINN1, 1 = AINP2/AINN2

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the TEMPEN / BUFEN pin levels (pins.levels); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (EC), p.5 (pins), p.11-14 (operation, data format, retrieval timing), p.15 (calibration, standby)
notModeled: analog inputs, buffer (BUFEN level stored only), temperature sensor (TEMPEN level stored only), reference
conversion time t7 = 8.32 ms (1 / data rate) at fCLK = 2 MHz (Figure 25); the data rate scales with CLK (120 SPS x fCLK / 2 MHz; the CLK pin is not used)
settling after a MUX, BUFEN or TEMPEN change: DRDY/DOUT held high for t1 = 26.4 ms (p.12); the model just continues converting
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless an extra SCLK forces it high; modeled as idle 1 after the data bits
self-calibration started by 26 SCLKs (the 25th forces DRDY/DOUT high, the 26th falling edge starts calibration)
standby mode (SCLK held high after DRDY/DOUT falls) and its wake-up
data-update window (no readback) and data overwritten if not read before the next update
VDD is the single analog and digital supply (power, not in analog)
